author: ojiudezue
title: Perimeter silence after v5.108.20 was a pre-existing global door-camera mute, a real security gap
summary: Carded PERIMETER-GLOBAL-EGRESS-MUTE-1: suppress only for a recognised resident at a related door, scoped by camera adjacency, bounded in length, logged as a gate decision. v5.108.20's new paths still await their first live run.
why: Zero alerts and zero gate rows after the restart looked like a regression. The trace showed any door-camera edge mutes ALL perimeter cameras for 120 s before any gate runs, and busy doors after an arrival kept renewing it (12 driveway detections dropped over 25 min). Not in the v5.108.20 diff.
implications: A stranger on the driveway while a resident is at a door would never alert until this ships.
revisit_trigger: When the first perimeter_gate_decision row appears, close v5.108.20 live validation.
